In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is insufficient evidence to support or refute the use of multimedia education in patients with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
there is no evidence that the use of a multimedia education package improves the clinical outcome of patients with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
the effectiveness of multimedia educational interventions in patients with T2DM is inconclusive.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the results from our study suggest that the use of multimedia education is effective in increasing knowledge and self-management skills in patients with type 1 and type 2 diabetes.
the results of this meta-analysis suggest that multimedia education is effective in improving knowledge, self-management, and glycemic control among patients with type 1 and type 2 diabetes.
the effectiveness of multimedia education on patients’ diabetes self-efficacy and knowledge, and the effectiveness of multimedia and traditional education on patients’ HbA1c, are still controversial.
